definitions.explanation: An instrument for measuring air temperature. Literally 'cold-warm meter.' Used specifically for room or outdoor thermometers, not for medical thermometers.

examples.japanese: {寒暖計|かんだんけい}を{見|み}る。
{寒暖計|かんだんけい}が{零下|れいか}5{度|ど}を{示|しめ}している。
{壁|かべ}に{掛|か}けた{寒暖計|かんだんけい}で{部屋|へや}の{温度|おんど}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked the room temperature on the thermometer hanging on the wall.

notes:
USAGE:
{寒暖計|かんだんけい} refers to thermometers for measuring ambient air temperature. For medical thermometers used to measure body temperature, the word {体温計|たいおんけい} is used instead.

WORD FORMATION:
{寒|かん} (cold) + {暖|だん} (warm) + {計|けい} (meter/gauge).

RELATED WORDS:
{温度計|おんどけい} is a more general term for any thermometer. {体温計|たいおんけい} is specifically for measuring body temperature.
